document: Context-owned history and scoped undo guard fixes
status: All three prior gates fixed; unchanged bounded strict contract green. No complete architecture acceptance.

node.note: Includes original raw-history failure reproducer; not84 product acceptance tests.

verification.native12: Not-run. Earlier native/manual09 passes remain intact; targeted native smoke can be batched before final acceptance.

implementation.ownership: OriginAuthority lazily owns one OriginHistoryContext per editing context. Public PM/Y bridge has no EditorView/DOM/binding reference and no view-disposal manager hook. Context/authority disposal owns destruction.
implementation.selection: Public relative/model bookmark APIs restore backward text, node, all-document and selected-cell history states.
implementation.step_guard: Mapped foreign mark ranges/node attribute spans. Unknown opaque effects remain conservative; overlapping foreign text/formatting/attributes remain protected.
implementation.origin_guard: Mapped affected-table scope over a derived accepted-change journal; no independent global watermark/revision counter or stored document copies.
implementation.lifecycle_proof: True destroyed/replaced EditorViews, repeated A/B cycles, foreign changes while closed and paused own edits while closed; undo/redo/new capture remain usable.

limits: Guards remain conservative within overlapping scopes; no complete property-level or cell-level semantic ownership.
History metadata/session receipts remain ephemeral, no production retention/performance/disk guarantee.
No dependency version/lock, native case/Swift or production change; isolated package adds tests/script.
Raw failures and original manual reports remain unchanged; no broad manual rerun requested.
next: Freeze/execute bounded durable-owner proof: atomic document/revision/operation outcome, uncertain acknowledgement, process restart, one owner across app/CLI/MCP; durable operation identity separate from session capability. Then architecture/ADRs.
delivery: Clutter R07 Context History Fix12 patch over exact bundle11 target; no agent commit/push/branch change.
